Sara (CEO): Short Friday brief 
Sara (CEO): 1) Customer-facing ask: we need a 1-paragraph note on the new 90d default retention + opt-in 365d, ready Mon 09:00 UTC. Jules + Lina.
Sara (CEO): 2) Launch window: regional private rollout (EU) set for Wed 07:30 UTC. Ops + Eng confirm CI checks by Tue.
Sara (CEO): 3) Incident recap: small group saw retries overnight due to a scheduler bug; auto-fallback worked. Postmortem tomorrow.
Sara (CEO): Quick metrics: p95 hosted ~120ms, errors 0.6% (close to goal).
Sara (CEO): Asks: docs/comms/legal produce customer copy; Eng/SRE prioritize scheduler fix and hold non-critical console changes until GA. Acks? :eyes:

Ravi (VP Product): Ack. I'll create a single PR with copy + UI text and tag @docs @legal. Will include model list for finance.

Maya (VP Eng): Ack on freeze. Scheduler fix in review; small patch to scheduler backoff. Pushing to canary now.

Maya (VP Eng): Patch snippet:
```
// add backoff for job retries
if (job.retries > 2) sleep(backoff_ms);
```

Lina (Head Legal): I'll draft the retention FAQ and quick legal bullets. ETA Mon 08:30.

Omar (SRE): Incident note: root cause = rare edge in scheduler timer; mitigation applied (increase jitter). Rolling postmortem tomorrow.

Jules (Comms): I'll draft the customer paragraph and internal FAQ. Will share by Mon 08:45 for review.

billbot: deployment queued for `private-eu-rollout` (commit c9d8fa) by @Maya  ETA ~26m.

Sara (CEO): Thanks all. I'll mention two bullets in Monday all-hands. Ping me if anything blocks sign-off. :handshake:
